entries.title: Crowded rails keep every panel within reach
entries.body: When the window is too short for every panel on a side, the panels nearest the middle fold to their headers, then gather in a More row. Expand a panel yourself to keep it open longer. Choosing one from More moves it closer to the end of its side, and it keeps that place after you reopen Infinitary.

picture.alt: The More menu lists Paris and Sydney above a rail’s counted More row.
